text:
Maya R.: quick heads-up — meeting w/ Azure SI tomorrow about marketplace private offers & co-announce timing. Need a recommendation for commit smoothing + an escape clause. can we sync?

Jon P.: +1. My draft: 6-mo rolling commit, monthly true-up; escape clause = 30d notice with a ramp-down cap (max 25% reduction per month). Keeps customers from churning revenue overnight. :thinking:

Anish K.: SI asked for onboarding credits to fund PoCs. proposal: convert onboarding credits into committed spend if customer opts into 12-mo term within 90 days. Otherwise credit expires. Good way to push conversion.

Tara L.: Renewal edge-case — what if customer never uses credits? recommend option to apply unused credits to next term at 50-60% value (explicit consent at signup). avoids unexpected charges.

Jon P.: legal flagged auto-convert as risky. explicit opt-in at purchase is OK. Also suggest a short 'escape window' within first 30 days to cancel before commit binds.

Maya R.: timeline Q — HW partner wants to sync announcement. suggestion: soft-launch to partner portal & SI customers first, public marketplace listing 2 wks later.

Anish K.: agreed. also propose we expose a 'commit meter' in marketplace UI so SIs can see conversion progress. small UX note for product team.

Maya R.: can someone draft the commit wording and the escape clause bullets? I'll bring to the Azure meeting. assign: Jon for legal wording, Anish for credits flow, Tara for renewal optics.

Sam Ops Bot: created doc: https://redwood.atlassian.org/browse/MP-1298 — 'Commit smoothing & channel timing' (internal). :white_check_mark:

Jon P.: will drop a 1-pager by EOD with sample tiers:

```
Tier A: $50k/mo commit -> 10% discount + $5k onboarding credit (expires 90d)
Tier B: $25k/mo commit -> 7% discount + $3k onboarding credit
Escape clause: 30d notice, max 25% monthly ramp-down, full termination allowed only after 3 months notice
```

Tara L.: thanks — will review and add renewal language. :thumbsup:

Maya R.: perfect. see you at the sync tomorrow 9:30 PST.
